scenario.summary: Guest searches the configurable parent with personalizable attributes by SKU and opens its PDP. Head of the class chain: declares every record the chain uses (the parent and four distinct variants of it).
steps: Open the webstore and click the logo
Type the parent SKU in the search box
assertions: Product image and breadcrumb visible on the opened PDP (page-object checks)
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): personalizeAttributeSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1, variant2, variant3, variant4); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no needs of their own.

Sources: parent SKU b-100004 -> product.parentProductSku (preferred, not required). Imported from the consumers' scans: the four variant SKUs (H209 z-2510001, I209 z-2510002, J209 z-2520007, K209 z-2510011) -> variant1..variant4.variantSku in method order.

Personalization: the first variant method types into the inputs with id DisplayText and AdditionalInformation (PersonalizeAttribute1/2, attribute codes used as element ids) the texts PersonalizeAttributeText1/2. The attribute codes are pinned by the test (config); the need pins personalizationAttribute AdditionalInformation with minPersonalizableAttributes 1, as the approved shoppingCart personalize entry. Gap (needsReview): the key takes one attribute code (the count is filtered by it), so DisplayText is not guaranteed on a fallback product; the migrated test then skips that input.

Four variants of ONE parent: PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS outputs variant1..variant3 only. New key PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_VARIANT_OF_PARENT (pending, proposed with the ConfigurableProductDisplayPageTest entries): one row per eligible variant of the parent passed in parentSku, identity variantSku; variant1..variant4 link parentSku to @product.parentProductSku and get four distinct variants. minVariants 4 keeps the parent to ones with four eligible variants.

Read by the page object, not scanned: selectConfigurableAttributes reads ProductSize/ProductColor/Technology of the variant's column -> variantN.swatches (attribute values in display order). No source entries: the cells are not in any scan and the workbook is not read.
Quantities: each variant is added three times with quantity 1 (InitialQuantity, config), one cart line per personalization; quantityUsed 3 on the parent and the variants.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
